welcome.laterHint: You can always start a tour from Help → Take a tour.

controls.targetUnavailable: This control isn't on your screen right now, so here is a description instead.
controls.paused: Tour paused. Resume it from Help → Guided tours.

completion.title: You're ready
completion.body: Replay this tour whenever you like from Help → Take a tour.

library.title: Guided tours
library.intro: Short, optional walkthroughs. Each one has a text version, and none of them is required to use the system.
library.practiceBody: Try real steps with fictional data. Nothing is saved, sent or charged.
library.noTours: There are no tours for your role in this app yet.

practice.banner: TRAINING / DEMO: no real transaction. Practice data is discarded when you finish.
practice.ended: Practice ended. Training records were discarded.
practice.title: Practice mode
practice.intro: Practice uses the same screens as real work, but every action is simulated with fictional data. No message, booking or payment can be created.
practice.leadTaskBody: Open Quick Create, fill in the practice lead form and submit it.
practice.comingLater: Sales, inventory, finance and maintenance practice tasks arrive with their screens in Stage 3.

preferences.title: Guided tours
preferences.autoOfferHint: Offer a short tour the first time you open an area. Tours never start without your choice.
preferences.textOnly: Use the text guide instead of the spotlight

preferences.resetConfirmBody: All tours for this identity will show as not started, and the welcome will be offered again. Nothing else changes.

GLOBAL-TOUR-001.name: Backoffice essentials
GLOBAL-TOUR-001.summary: A short walk through the dashboard and the controls you’ll use every day.

welcome.title: Welcome to your workspace
welcome.body: Everything you need to run sales, inventory and collections is on this dashboard. This short tour highlights the real controls, one at a time. You can pause or skip at any point.

sidebar.title: Your work areas
sidebar.body: Sales, projects, customers, finance and more. You only see the areas your role includes.
sidebar.bodyMobile: On a phone, your main areas are in this bar. More opens everything else.

project.title: Current project
project.body: Filter your work to a particular project. You can switch back to all your projects at any time.

search.title: Search anything
search.body: Press Ctrl+K or select Search to find a customer, unit, invoice, screen or action. Try it now, or choose Next.
search.bodyMobile: Tap Search to find a customer, unit, invoice, screen or action. Try it now, or choose Next.

quickCreate.title: Quick create
quickCreate.body: Start a lead, a visit or another task you’re allowed to do, without leaving the screen you’re on.

help.title: Help is always here
help.body: Replay this tour, pause and resume it, or read help for the current page from Help.

kpis.title: Today’s numbers at a glance
kpis.body: Bookings, collections and available stock for the period you choose. Select a card to open the screen behind the number.

quickActions.title: Quick actions
quickActions.body: The jobs you do most often, one tap away: add a lead, book a visit, check stock and more.

actionCentre.title: What needs you now
actionCentre.body: Follow-ups due, payment proofs awaiting verification and expiring holds. Proofs stay “Awaiting verification” until finance confirms them.

collections.title: Collections against target
collections.body: Money collected each month against what was scheduled. Use the arrow keys on the chart, or open its data table.

LAB-TOUR-001.name: Practice: create a fictional lead
LAB-TOUR-001.summary: Try Quick Create and a real form with training data.

intro.title: What practice mode is
intro.body: You'll use real controls with fictional data. Nothing is saved, sent or charged, and a TRAINING banner stays visible.

openQuickCreate.title: Open Quick Create
openQuickCreate.body: Open Quick Create and choose “New lead (practice)”. The tour continues when the form opens.

fillForm.title: Fill in the practice lead
fillForm.body: Enter a name and mobile number, choose a project and unit, then submit. The tour continues when the practice lead is created.

financeReview.title: Transfer proof review
financeReview.body: Finance officers verify bank-transfer proofs in Finance. An uploaded proof is never treated as payment until it is verified.

replay.title: Replay any time
replay.body: Find this tour and the essentials tour in Help → Guided tours.

CRM-TOUR-001.name: Sales workspace
CRM-TOUR-001.summary: Follow-ups, the pipeline, site visits, and creating your first demo lead.

intro.title: Your sales workspace
intro.body: Leads, follow-ups, site visits and bookings in one place. Let’s look at the parts you’ll use every day, then create a demo lead together.

kpis.title: Your week in four numbers
kpis.body: New leads, follow-ups due, visits this week and bookings this month. Each card opens the list behind it.

followUps.title: Follow-ups due
followUps.body: Who to call today, overdue first. Call or WhatsApp straight from the card and log the outcome.

pipeline.title: Pipeline
pipeline.body: How many leads sit at each stage and what they’re worth. Select a stage to see those leads.

visits.title: Upcoming site visits
visits.body: Confirm a visit, or mark it done after the customer has seen the unit.

newLead.title: Create a demo lead
newLead.body: Select New lead, fill in a name and phone number, and save. It’s fictional demo data: nothing is sent to anyone.

recentLeads.title: Your new lead is here
recentLeads.body: New leads appear at the top of the list straight away, with a “New” marker. Open one to see its timeline.

done.title: You’re ready
done.body: Replay this tour from Help at any time, or keep exploring the demo on your own.
